column1: Scale as needed: use 1 large egg for every 100g of semolina flour.
Mound the flour, mix in the salt, and make a well in the center.
Crack the egg into the well, beat it with a fork, and gradually draw in the flour.
Combine into a dough and knead until smooth.
Wrap and rest in the fridge for 24 hours, or on the counter for about 30 minutes (estimate) if short on time.
